era: Arcade / Saturn / Dreamcast / PlayStation 2 / HD consoles / mobile
summary: Sega's arcade rally racing series, from Model 2/Model 3 cabinets through Dreamcast, PS2, Revo, mobile, and Online Arcade.

entries.title: Sega Rally Championship
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Rally Championship Plus on Saturn

emulation.notes: Use Saturn route for the complete home version; Model 2 emulation for arcade comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-accuracy Saturn emulation or Model 2 arcade fidelity

primary.platform: Sega Saturn / Sega Rally Championship Plus
primary.why: The Model 2 arcade game is the original fidelity baseline, but the Saturn version was highly praised for accuracy, adds home options such as three-lap races and unlockable content, and the enhanced Saturn Plus release supports analog control and NetLink online play. It is the most complete practical classic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sega Rally Championship Plus on Saturn hardware or a high-accuracy Saturn emulator; use Model 2 arcade emulation only for cabinet-fidelity comparison.

emulation.notes: Use Windows for complete home content; use Supermodel for arcade comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC or Model 3 arcade fidelity

primary.why: Sega Rally 2 began on Model 3 arcade hardware and was ported to Dreamcast and Windows. The Dreamcast/PC versions add many courses and tuning options not found in arcades, while the Dreamcast version suffered unstable frame rate; Windows is the most complete home route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version on a compatible PC/compatibility setup; use Dreamcast or arcade emulation only if you specifically want those versions.

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for high-resolution PS2 play.

primary.why: Sega Rally 2006 was released only for PlayStation 2 in Japan and Asia and was the first Sega Rally not originally developed for arcades. It includes career and arcade modes with unlocks tied to the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese/Asian PS2 release on original hardware or PCSX2 with internal-resolution upscale.

entries.title: Sega Rally Revo
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release plus PSP track supplement

emulation.emulator: Native PC / PPSSPP for PSP supplement
emulation.notes: Use an owned PC copy for the main route; use PPSSPP only for the PSP track supplement.

primary.why: Sega Rally Revo released on PS3, Xbox 360, PSP, and Windows, with dynamic terrain deformation and 34 vehicles. Windows is the highest-fidelity/configurable route, but the PSP version was developed separately and uses its own track set, making it a secondary supplement.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release if already owned; the game is source-documented as unavailable because of car licensing, so preserve existing legitimate copies.

secondary.exclusive_content: Portable version with its own tracks rather than the senior-version track set
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the PSP version for its unique track set.
secondary.why: It is lower fidelity, but the source-documented track differences make it a true supplement.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game became unavailable because of time-limited real-world car licensing.

primary.why: Sega Rally 3D is a 2007 J2ME mobile entry. No other platform route exists, so it remains a mobile preservation entry.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a mobile preservation title; play only through an already-owned legitimate Java phone copy or compatible J2ME preservation setup.

entries.title: Sega Rally 3 / Sega Rally Online Arcade
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Rally Online Arcade if already owned

emulation.emulator: Original arcade hardware / PS3 or Xbox 360 entitlement
emulation.notes: Use previously purchased Online Arcade for content completeness; arcade cabinet for authentic hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD console output or Sega Europa-R cabinet fidelity

primary.why: Sega Rally 3 was a 2008 arcade sequel, and its 2011 PSN/XBLA port, Sega Rally Online Arcade, is essentially the same title with extras including the original 1995 Desert track. The home port is delisted, but it is the most complete released version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sega Rally Online Arcade on PS3/Xbox 360 only if previously purchased; otherwise seek an arcade cabinet for the original Sega Rally 3 experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted from PSN/XBLA in 2012; no current remaster documented.
